name: weak-entity
description: Clean site whose identity signals are weak: JSON-LD names the organisation 'LedgerPro Software' while every page says 'Ledgerly'; sameAs lists only Facebook and Twitter; the footer has an email but no address or phone and a copyright year three years old; the newsroom page's JSON-LD dateModified is 400 days behind the dates shown on it.

expected.notes: All five entity/freshness fails are low for a saas_software site (nap is medium by default, low by category override). sameAs is present, so sameas_missing passes and sameas_no_authority fires (facebook/twitter are not authorities). name_inconsistent: 'LedgerPro Software' (JSON-LD) versus 'Ledgerly' (og:site_name, titles). nap: contact page keeps the email; address and phone appear only in JSON-LD, which does not count as visible text. stale_copyright_year: footer year is {{STALE_YEAR}} (three years back); the 'Last updated' time element keeps no_visible_dates green. date_modified_mismatch: only the blog page, WebPage.dateModified {{DATE_MINUS_400}} against visible {{DATE}}/{{DATE_MINUS_10}}.
